multi_entity_note: Amendment between Fox Mobile Entertainment (as administrator for Twentieth Century Fox) and Glu Mobile.

contract.document_name.rationale: The document is titled Amendment No. 3; the Wireless Content License Agreement is the underlying agreement it amends.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The amendment is dated as of February 19, 2007; the 2004/2005/2006 dates belong to the underlying agreement and prior amendments.

contract.effective_date.rationale: No effective date of the amendment is stated; 'Effective Date' is only a reference to a defined term of the underlying agreement.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The replaced term clause states the Term expires on December 31, 2006; March 31, 2008 is a per-Property continuation of rights, not the Term expiry.

contract.governing_law.rationale: No governing law is stated in the amendment.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No non-renewal notice period is stated.
